archetypes.name: scrub-boundary
archetypes.rationale: Scrub failures now cross process boundaries and must remain fail-closed only for secret faults.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the design log publish and publish-tail changes for scrub failure classification. Focus on whether only explicit redaction/scrubber failures become fatal and whether push, PR, worktree, init, and ordinary commit misses remain recoverable. Check that rotation warnings still appear after successful scrubbing only. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: tally-parity
archetypes.rationale: Audit and fluff now share tally expansion while retaining caller-specific row shapes.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the shared self-review tally helper and its callers. Verify canonical int(str(value)) coercion, independent accepted/rejected count handling, accepted-before-rejected ordering, and unchanged audit/fluff output records. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
